content: In light of the success of Universal Dependencies BIBREF3, we hope that our initiative will instigate a collaborative public effort with established and clear-cut guidelines that will result in additional Multi-SimLex datasets in a large number of languages in the near future. Moreover, we hope that it will provide means to advance our understanding of distributional and lexical semantics across a large number of languages. All monolingual and cross-lingual Multi-SimLex datasets–along with detailed translation and annotation guidelines–are available online at: https://multisimlex.com/.
